questions.title: 範例3：設$\begin{bmatrix} x + y & u + v \
questions.question_text: 設$\begin{bmatrix} x + y & u + v \ u & x - y \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & 7 \ 3 & - 1 \end{bmatrix}$，試求$x$，$y$，$u$與$v$的值.
questions.explanation_text: 【解析】 $x = 1$，$y = 2$，$u = 3$，$v = 4$. 利用矩陣相等的定義知${ \begin{array}{r} x + y = 3 \ x - y = - 1 \end{array} \right.$，${ \begin{array}{r} u + v = 7 \ u = - 1 \end{array} \right.$, 解得$x = 1$，$y = 2$，$u = 3$，$v = 4$.

questions.title: 範例4：設$\begin{bmatrix} sin 2\theta & a
questions.question_text:
設$\begin{bmatrix} sin 2\theta & a
(sin\theta - cos\theta)^{2} & c \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \frac{1}{3} & (sin\theta + cos\theta)^{2} \ b & tan\theta + cot\theta \end{bmatrix}$﹐則a + b + c =
(1)8 (2)− 8 (3)7 (4)− 7﹒.
questions.explanation_text:
【解析】由原式可知sin 2θ =$\frac{1}{3}$﹐則 a = (sinθ + cosθ)^2^ = 1 + 2sinθ cosθ = 1 + sin2θ = $\frac{4}{3}$﹐ b = (sinθ − cotθ)^2^ = 1 − 2sinθ cosθ = 1 − sin2θ = $\frac{2}{3}$﹐ c = tanθ + cotθ = $\frac{sin^{2}\theta + cos^{2}\theta}{sin\thetacos\theta} = \frac{1}{sin\thetacos\theta} = \frac{2}{sin 2\theta} = 6$﹐
∴a + b + c = $\frac{4}{3} + \frac{2}{3} + 6 = 8$﹐故選(1)﹒

questions.title: 隨堂練習：設$\begin{bmatrix} cos\theta + sin\
questions.question_text: 設$\begin{bmatrix} cos\theta + sin\theta & sin 2\theta \ cos 2\theta & cos\theta - sin\theta \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \frac{1}{2} & a \ b & c \end{bmatrix}$﹐其中$b > 0$﹐$c > 0$﹐試求$4a + 2b - c$之值﹒
questions.explanation_text:
【解析】 依題意得知
[圖:program-db/assets/question-media/s4-4-2/image6.png] ﹐
∴ $(cos\theta + sin\theta)^{2} = 1 + sin 2\theta = \frac{1}{4}$﹐得$sin 2\theta = - \frac{3}{4}$﹐即$a = - \frac{3}{4}$﹒
又$b = cos 2\theta = \sqrt{1 - sin^{2}2\theta} = \sqrt{1 - ( - \frac{3}{4})^{2}} = \frac{\sqrt{7}}{4}$﹐ $c = \sqrt{(cos\theta - sin\theta)^{2}} = \sqrt{1 - sin 2\theta} = \sqrt{1 - ( - \frac{3}{4})} = \frac{\sqrt{7}}{2}$﹐ 故$4a + 2b - c = 4 × ( - \frac{3}{4}) + 2 × \frac{\sqrt{7}}{4} - \frac{\sqrt{7}}{2} = - 3$﹒

∴
[圖:program-db/assets/question-media/s4-4-2/image26.png] $\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}$=
[圖:program-db/assets/question-media/s4-4-2/image27.png] $\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \ 5 & 6 \end{bmatrix}$但$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}$≠$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \ 5 & 6 \end{bmatrix}$
(4)舉例：

questions.title: 範例2：設A，B均為2階方陣，I為2階單位方陣，下列敘述何者正確？ (A)若
questions.question_text:
設A，B均為2階方陣，I為2階單位方陣，下列敘述何者正確？
(A)若A^2^ = O，則A = O (B)若A^2^ = I，則A = I或A = − I (C)若A^2^ = A，則A = O或A = I (D)若AB = O，則BA = O (E)若AB = O，det A ≠ 0，則B = O
questions.explanation_text:
【解析】
(A) A =$\begin{bmatrix} \text{ }2 & \text{ }1 \ - 4 & - 2 \end{bmatrix}$ ≠ O ⇒ A^2^ =$\begin{bmatrix} \text{ }2 & \text{ }1 \ - 4 & - 2 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} \text{ }2 & \text{ }1 \ - 4 & - 2 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$= O
(B) A =$\begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 \ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$ ≠ I或 − I ⇒ A^2^ =$\begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 \ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 \ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$ = I
(C) A =$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$ ≠ O或I ⇒ A^2^ =$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$= A
(D) A =$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$，B =$\begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$
⇒ AB =$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$= O，BA =$\begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix} ≠$O
(E) AB = O，det A ≠ 0 ⇒ A ^−\ 1^存在 ⇒ A ^−\ 1^(AB) = A ^−\ 1^．O ⇒ IB = O ⇒ B = O 故選(E)

questions.title: 範例4：若方陣A =$\begin{bmatrix} \begin{arra
questions.question_text: 若方陣A =$\begin{bmatrix} \begin{array}{r} cos\theta \ sin\theta \end{array} & \begin{array}{r} - sin\theta \ \text{ }cos\theta \end{array} \end{bmatrix}$且A^3^ = I，且0 < θ ≤ π，則θ = ＿＿＿＿＿＿。
questions.explanation_text: 【解析】 A =$\begin{bmatrix} \begin{array}{r} cos\theta \ sin\theta \end{array} & \begin{array}{r} - sin\theta \ \text{ }cos\theta \end{array} \end{bmatrix}$時，A^3^ =$\begin{bmatrix} \begin{array}{r} cos 3\theta \ sin 3\theta \end{array} & \begin{array}{r} - sin 3\theta \ \text{ }cos 3\theta \end{array} \end{bmatrix}$=$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$，所以${ \begin{array}{r} cos 3\theta = 1 \ sin 3\theta = 0 \end{array} \right.$，又0 < θ ≤ π 時，0 < 3θ ≤ 3π，此時3θ = 2π，即θ =$\frac{2π}{3}$

questions.title: 範例5：設$0 ≤ \theta ≤ \frac{π}{2}$，且A =$\
questions.question_text: 設$0 ≤ \theta ≤ \frac{π}{2}$，且A =$\begin{bmatrix} \text{cos}\theta & - \text{sin}\theta \ \text{sin}\theta & \text{ cos}\theta \end{bmatrix}$，若A^12^ = I~2~，求$\theta$之值。
questions.explanation_text: 【解析】 A^12^ =$\begin{bmatrix} cos\theta & - sin\theta \ sin\theta & \text{ }cos\theta \end{bmatrix}^{12}$=$\begin{bmatrix} cos 12\theta & - sin 12\theta \ sin 12\theta & \text{ }cos 12\theta \end{bmatrix}$=$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$，所以cos12θ = 1且sin12θ = 0 因0 ≤ θ ≤$\frac{π}{2}$，所以0 ≤ 12θ ≤ 6π，故12θ = 0，2π，4π，6π，即θ = 0，$\frac{π}{6}$，$\frac{π}{3}$，$\frac{π}{2}$

questions.question_text: 設A =$\begin{bmatrix} \text{ }sin 75{^\circ} & cos 75{^\circ} \ - cos 75{^\circ} & sin 75{^\circ} \end{bmatrix}$，n ∈ N，若A^n^ = I =$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$，則n之最小值= ＿＿＿＿＿＿。
questions.explanation_text:
【解析】 A =$\begin{bmatrix} \text{ }sin 75{^\circ} & cos 75{^\circ} \ - cos 75{^\circ} & sin 75{^\circ} \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \text{ cos1}5{^\circ} & sin 15{^\circ} \ - sin 15{^\circ} & cos 15{^\circ} \end{bmatrix}$
⇒ A^2^ =
[圖:program-db/assets/question-media/s4-4-2/image33.png] $\begin{bmatrix} \text{ cos1}5{^\circ} & sin 15{^\circ} \ - sin 15{^\circ} & cos 15{^\circ} \end{bmatrix}$=$\begin{bmatrix} \text{ cos30}{^\circ} & sin 30{^\circ} \ - sin 30{^\circ} & cos 30{^\circ} \end{bmatrix}$ 由數學歸納法可得知A^n^ =$\begin{bmatrix} cos(15{^\circ} × n) & sin(15{^\circ} × n) \ - sin(15{^\circ} × n) & cos(15{^\circ} × n) \end{bmatrix}$
⇒ 欲A^n^ = I ⇒ 15° × n = 360° × k，k ∈ N
⇒ n = 24k，k ∈ N ∴ n之最小值 = 24

questions.title: 範例6：設矩陣A =$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 3 \ - 1
questions.question_text:
設矩陣A =$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 3 \ - 1 & - 2 \end{bmatrix}$，E =$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$，O =$\begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$，若a，b ∈ R已知A^2^ + a．A + b．E = O，則
(1)a + b = ＿＿＿＿＿＿。 (2)A^77^ = ＿＿＿＿＿＿。
questions.explanation_text:
【解析】(1)已知A^2^ + a．A + b．E = O
∴
[圖:program-db/assets/question-media/s4-4-2/image34.png] $\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 3 \ - 1 & - 2 \end{bmatrix}$+ a$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 3 \ - 1 & - 2 \end{bmatrix}$+ b$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$=$\begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$
∴ $\begin{bmatrix} - 2 + a + b & - 3 + 3a \ 1 - a & 1 - 2a + b \end{bmatrix}$=$\begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$
∴ − 2 + a + b = 0，故a + b = 2
(2)A =$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 3 \ - 1 & - 2 \end{bmatrix}$ A^2^ = A．A =

[圖:program-db/assets/question-media/s4-4-2/image36.png] $\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 3 \ - 1 & - 2 \end{bmatrix}$=$\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}·s$
∴ A^77^ = A^2^ =$\begin{bmatrix} - 2 & - 3 \ 1 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$

questions.title: 範例10：設 A、B、C 均為 n 階方陣，判斷何者恆成立
questions.question_text:
設$A$﹐$B$﹐$C$均為$n$階方陣﹐則下列敘述何者恆成立？
(1)$AB = BA$ (2)若$AB = O$﹐則$A = O$或$B = O$
(3)若$A$不為零矩陣且$AB = AC$，則$B = C$
(4)若$A^{2} = B^{2}$﹐則$A = B$或$A = - B$
(5)$(AB)C = A(BC)$﹒
questions.explanation_text:
【解析】(1)矩陣乘法沒有交換律﹐∴ 不成立﹒
(2)例：$A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 \ 1 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$﹐$B = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & - 1 \ - 1 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$ 均不為零矩陣﹐ 但
[圖:program-db/assets/question-media/s4-4-2/image47.png] $= \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$﹒
(3)例：$A = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 2 \ 1 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$﹐$B = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 \ 3 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$﹐$C = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 2 \ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$﹐ $AB = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 2 \ 1 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 \ 3 & 1 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 6 & 4 \ 3 & 2 \end{bmatrix}$﹐ $AC = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 2 \ 1 & 1 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 2 & 2 \ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 6 & 4 \ 3 & 2 \end{bmatrix}$﹐
∴ $AB = AC$﹐但$B ≠ C$﹒
(4)例：$A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$﹐$A^{4} =$﹐ 則$A^{20} =$﹐$B^{2} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \ 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$﹐
∴ $A^{2} = B^{2}$﹐但$A ≠ B$且$A ≠ - B$﹒
故選(5)﹒

questions.title: 範例11：設$A$﹐$B$﹐$C$為同階方陣﹐$t$為實數﹐則下列敘述何者恆成
questions.question_text:
設$A$﹐$B$﹐$C$為同階方陣﹐$t$為實數﹐則下列敘述何者恆成立？
(1)$A + B = B + A$
(2)$(A + B) - C = A + (B - C)$
(3)$(tA)B = A(tB)$
(4)$(AB)^{2} = A^{2}B^{2}$
(5)若$AB = O$﹐則$BA = O$﹒
questions.explanation_text:
【解析】(4)$(AB)^{2} = (AB) ． (AB) ≠ A^{2}B^{2}$﹒
(5)例：$A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 3 \ 2 & 6 \end{bmatrix}$﹐$B = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 0 \ - 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$﹐則$AB = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 3 \ 2 & 6 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 2 & 0 \ - 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 0 \ 0 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$﹐ $BA = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 0 \ - 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 3 \ 2 & 6 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 6 \ - 1 & - 3 \end{bmatrix}$﹒
故選(1)(2)(3)﹒
